def.en: The skill of questioning what you see online or on TV: who made it, why, what was left out and whether it is true.
def.hg: Online ya TV pe jo dikhe uspe sawaal karne ki skill: kisne banaya, kyun banaya, kya chhod diya gaya aur kya yeh sach hai.

def.en: A setting in a camera or app that automatically changes how a photo or video looks, such as smoothing skin or changing face shape.
def.hg: Camera ya app ki aisi setting jo photo ya video ka look automatically badal deti hai, jaise skin smooth karna ya face shape badalna.

def.en: A post that a brand has paid for or rewarded, so the creator has a reason to praise the product.
def.hg: Aisi post jiske liye kisi brand ne paise ya reward diya ho, isliye creator ke paas product ki tareef karne ki wajah hoti hai.

def.en: A person with many online followers whose posts can shape what those followers buy, believe or copy.
def.hg: Aisa insaan jiske online bahut followers hon aur jiski posts is pe asar daal sakti hain ki woh followers kya khareedein, kya maanein ya kya copy karein.

def.en: The set of computer rules an app uses to decide which posts and videos to show you next, based on what you watched before.
def.hg: Computer ke woh rules jinse koi app decide karta hai ki tumhe aage kaun-si posts aur videos dikhane hain, is basis pe ki tumne pehle kya dekha.

def.en: A shocking or exaggerated headline or thumbnail designed to make you click, even when the content does not match the promise.
def.hg: Shocking ya badha-chadha ke banayi gayi headline ya thumbnail, jo tumse click karwane ke liye banti hai, chahe andar ka content promise se match na kare.

def.en: Scripted, edited videos, images or writing made to sexually arouse adult viewers; it is not an accurate picture of real relationships.
def.hg: Adult viewers ko sexually arouse karne ke liye banaye gaye scripted, edited videos, images ya writing; yeh real relationships ki sahi picture nahi hai.

def.en: A photo, video or audio clip made or altered with AI so that a real person appears to do or say something they never did.
def.hg: AI se banayi ya badli gayi photo, video ya audio clip, jisme lage ki kisi real insaan ne woh kiya ya kaha jo usne kabhi nahi kiya.

def.en: Sharing someone's private or sexual image without their permission. It is a form of abuse, often wrongly called 'revenge porn'.
def.hg: Kisi ki private ya sexual image uski permission ke bina share karna. Yeh abuse ka ek form hai, jise aksar galat tareeke se 'revenge porn' kaha jaata hai.

def.en: Blackmail in which someone threatens to share a person's real or fake intimate images unless they pay money or send more images.
def.hg: Aisa blackmail jisme koi dhamki deta hai ki paise ya aur images na mili toh woh kisi ki real ya fake intimate images share kar dega.

def.en: A one-sided feeling of closeness to a creator, celebrity or character who does not personally know you.
def.hg: Kisi creator, celebrity ya character se closeness ki one-sided feeling, jabki woh tumhe personally jaanta hi nahi.

def.en: Any sexual image or video of a person under 18. Creating, viewing, storing or sharing it is a serious crime in India.
def.hg: 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ki koi bhi sexual image ya video. India mein ise banana, dekhna, store karna ya share karna serious crime hai.
